verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes Garamond and a readable, sufficiently substantial article-body typeface as document-layout requirements.
First concrete failure: the client reviewed the magazine and found the primary article font too light or frail.
The freelancer's Inter recommendation conflicts with the client's Garamond preference and requires a client decision on the article-body typeface.
The client accepts Inter after reviewing the heavier sample, changing the article-body typeface and weight; overwriting body_typeface leaves no obsolete key requiring removal.
The client's acceptance of the heavier Inter sample resolves the typeface conflict and returns the article-body typography requirement to active execution.
First concrete verification of the revised type treatment: the client reviewed the paragraph using heavier Inter and approved it.
Distinct final-deliverable verification: the client reports that the delivered magazine's typography was handled extremely well.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
OK, that works.

The Inter font is nice, but after reviewing all the choices, it seems too thin. A typeface that is more readable and gentler on the eyes would be preferable for article pages.
